test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **What does the speaker recommend to the parents as the best path to take?**

options.text: To advise children at every step so that they do not make mistakes.
To handle the children with authority and make them obey.
To be a part of the children's world by listening to them.
To spend all their time with the children and not leave them alone.

solution:
The correct answer is** ****To be a part of the children's world by listening to them.**
